identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of AMG 706 in Subjects With Advanced Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GISTs)
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Label Study of AMG 706 in Subjects With Advanced Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors (GISTs) Who Developed Progressive Disease or Relapsed While on Imatinib Mesylate

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will determine the safety and effectiveness of AMG 706 in patients with advanced GIST.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Expanded Access: Amgen provides expanded access for this clinical trial. Contact the Amgen Call Center (866-572-6436) for more information.

interventions.name: AMG 706
interventions.description: AMG 706 125 mg daily for 48 weeks, or until progressive disease or unacceptable toxicity.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate as defined using modified RECIST criteria.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 48 weeks treatment or until progressive disease, or unacceptable toxicity

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: time from randomization to progressive disease
time from response to progressive disease
time from first treatment to response

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Use of opioid analgesics after minimal 6 months treatment
Objective response by PET and tumor size/density changes at week 8
Objective response by size changes and/or target tumor density changes at week 8
Safety Endpoints: Incidence of adverse events (including all, serious, grade 3, grade 4 and treatment related)
Pharmacokinetic Endpoints: 1. The AMG 706 PK parameters (Cmax, t1/2, AUC0-24, C24); 2. To explore the PK/PD relationships
